hints.calendar_desc: Add Local Calendar or Google Calendar (calendar.* entities) and events will appear in the agenda and month view.
hints.cams_desc: Add a camera via ONVIF, the manufacturer integration or Generic Camera (camera.* entities).
hints.climate_desc: Add a thermostat or air conditioner (climate.* entity), e.g. through the manufacturer integration.
hints.custom_desc: Add any widgets: entity tiles, groups, cameras, a map, a calendar and more. Change order and size in edit mode.
hints.fuel_desc: Needs a price sensor (e.g. a sensor from the REST or Scrape integration, unit zł/l).
hints.map_desc: Add people with the Home Assistant app on their phone or devices with location (device_tracker) and they will appear on the map.
hints.media_desc: Add a player: Google Cast, Sonos, Spotify or a TV (media_player.* entities).
hints.people_desc: Add people in HA and assign them a phone with the Home Assistant app to see who is home.
hints.power_desc: Needs a power sensor (W) from a meter, inverter or smart plug. You can also set up the Energy dashboard in HA.
hints.scenes_desc: Create a scene or script in HA and it will show up here as a button.
hints.weather_desc: Add the Met.no integration (free, no API key) or any weather.* entity.
